name: model3d-1
note: The 3D model examples of the shelf. A STILL lot: every picture is a real screenshot of the page the skill `model-3d` builds from the example of the same name (`node scripts/model3d-stills.mjs <pages> chair stool:700 grinder:800:Explode engine:1000`), nothing is generated, so no `made` and no Remix. The request of each one starts that skill (packages/kybernos-plugin/skills/model-3d/SKILL.md).

cells.request: Make an interactive 3D armchair configurator for my online shop: the customer turns it around, picks the fabric, the frame wood and the size, and the price follows. Ask me for my real options and prices first, or use sample ones labelled as sample.

entry.line: Pick the fabric, the frame and the size: the price follows.
entry.alt: A 3D armchair with a fabric, frame and size picker and a live price
